record.what_it_does: DealCloud (by Intapp) is a CRM and deal/relationship management platform for private equity, investment banking, and other capital markets firms, with a REST API for reading and writing site data.
record.auth_notes: Core REST API uses OAuth2 Client Credentials flow: a client_id plus a per-user 'API Key' (used as the client_secret) are exchanged at /api/rest/v1/oauth/token for a bearer token that expires after 15 minutes. The newer MCP Server instead uses a per-user, three-legged OAuth sign-in flow (no client ID/secret needed by the connecting app).
record.access_notes: DealCloud is an enterprise product sold to existing customers; there is no public self-serve signup or free trial for the API. Within a customer's site, an admin must enable the 'API' capability for a user group in Admin > User Management, and each individual user must then enable/copy their own API Key from their profile before any credentials work. The MCP Server additionally requires a 'DealCloud with Celeste' license and admin-granted 'Manage MCP Servers'/'MCP Access' permissions (currently client preview since July 2026).
record.main_blocker: No public self-serve signup — requires an existing paid DealCloud subscription plus admin-enabled API/user-group permissions per customer site
